import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import xgboost as xgb

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", 1000)
os.environ["XGBOOST_LOGGING_LEVEL"] = "ERROR"
xgb.__version__

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"
VAL_SPLIT_FRACTION = 0.2

# Paths Setup
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def compute_multiclass_logloss(y_true_indices, y_pred, n_classes=99):
    """Compute multi-class logloss with specified clipping."""
    # Convert indices to one-hot encoding
    n_samples = len(y_true_indices)
    y_true_onehot = np.zeros((n_samples, n_classes), dtype=np.float32)
    for idx, label_idx in enumerate(y_true_indices):
        if isinstance(label_idx, str):
            # Handle string labels by converting to numeric first
            pass
        else:
            y_true_onehot[idx, int(label_idx)] = 1.0

    # Normalize probabilities so rows sum to 1
    y_pred = np.array(y_pred, dtype=np.float32)
    row_sums = y_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1
    y_pred_norm = y_pred / row_sums

    # Apply clipping as per instructions: max(min(p, 1-1e-15), 1e-15)
    y_pred_clipped = np.minimum(np.maximum(y_pred_norm, 1e-15), 1 - 1e-15)

    # Avoid log(0) by using clipped values (already handled above)
    log_probs = np.log(y_pred_clipped)

    # Weighted sum of log probabilities
    weighted_sum = np.sum(y_true_onehot * log_probs, axis=1)
    total_logloss = -np.mean(weighted_sum)

    return float(total_logloss)


def get_species_list_from_sample(sample_sub):
    """Get sorted list of species names from sample submission header"""
    cols = [c for c in sample_sub.columns.tolist() if c != "id"]
    return sorted(cols)


def main():
    print("Loading Data...", flush=True)
    train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

    # Get species list from sample submission template
    species_names = get_species_list_from_sample(sample_sub)
    print(f"Found {len(species_names)} species to predict", flush=True)

    # Identify feature columns (exclude id, but check if species exists in train)
    train_cols = train_df.columns.tolist()
    feature_cols = []

    # Look for pattern: margin1..margin64, shape1..shape64, texture1..texture64
    # Based on data overview: margin1-margin178 (actually 16*64=1024? No, 64 attributes per type)
    # Rechecking: description says 64 attribute vectors per feature type
    # Total features = 192 (16 samples * 12 feature types mentioned?)
    # Actually: margin_1 to margin_64 = 64, shape_1 to shape_64 = 64, texture_1 to texture_64 = 64 = 192 total

    # From data overview: 193 columns in test (id + 192 features)
    # Need to find columns that start with margin_, shape_, or texture_
    feature_patterns = ["margin", "shape", "texture"]
    for pattern in feature_patterns:
        matching_cols = [col for col in train_cols if col.startswith(pattern)]
        feature_cols.extend(matching_cols)

    print(f"Selected {len(feature_cols)} feature columns", flush=True)
    print(f"Feature columns: {feature_cols[:10]}...{feature_cols[-10:]}")

    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
    print(f"Train shape: {X_train.shape}", flush=True)

    y_train_str = train_df["species"].values if "species" in train_cols else None
    if y_train_str is None:
        raise ValueError("Species column not found in train data")

    # Map species to indices
    species_order_map = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(species_names)}
    y_train_idx = np.array(
        [species_order_map[name] for name in y_train_str], dtype=np.int32
    )
    print(
        f"Training labels: {y_train_idx.min()} to {y_train_idx.max()} ({np.unique(y_train_idx).size} unique classes)",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Determine columns for submission matching sample format
    species_cols_to_submit = [c for c in sample_sub.columns.tolist() if c != "id"]
    print(
        f"Submission will have {len(species_cols_to_submit)} probability columns",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Create validation train split BEFORE training model
    np.random.seed(42)
    n_samples = len(train_df)
    indices = np.random.permutation(n_samples)
    val_size = int(n_samples * VAL_SPLIT_FRACTION)
    val_indices = indices[:val_size]
    train_indices = indices[val_size:]

    X_val = X_train[val_indices]
    y_val_idx = y_train_idx[val_indices]

    X_tr = X_train[train_indices]
    y_tr_idx = y_train_idx[train_indices]

    print(
        f"Training split: {len(train_indices)} samples, Validation: {len(val_indices)} samples",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Train Model (Simple Gradient Boosting)
    print("Training XGBoost Model...", flush=True)
    model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        eval_metric="mlogloss",
        random_state=42,
        verbosity=0,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr_idx)

    # Validation Metrics (Hold-out set)
    print("Validating on Hold-out Set...", flush=True)
    y_val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    val_loss = compute_multiclass_logloss(y_val_idx, y_val_proba, len(species_names))
    print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Test Predictions
    print("Generating Test Predictions...", flush=True)
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
    y_test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
    print(f"Test predictions shape: {y_test_proba.shape}", flush=True)

    # Prepare Submission - use sample submission template
    submission_data = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_df["id"],
        }
    )
    for idx, col_name in enumerate(species_cols_to_submit):
        submission_data[col_name] = y_test_proba[:, idx]

    # Save submission file
    submission_data.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}", flush=True)

    print("\n=== Competition Submission Complete ===")
    print(f"Validation Score (hold-out): {val_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"Test submissions generated: {len(test_df)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
